verdict.rationale: Bulk or batch processing, such as batch inference or batch transcription, is a fair question for an on-device AI SDK and CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents single-request APIs: generate, stream, transcribe, synthesize and structured output. The multi-file fields in DownloadProgress track the files of one model download, not user-driven bulk operations across many items, so there is no evidence of the capability.
